concerns.text: US-2 Independent Test says outputs include 'a confusion matrix (if classification) or regression plot' — but FR-004 mandates a Random Forest REGRESSOR; classification is out of scope. The conditional clause is untestable dead text; strike it so the test procedure is deterministic (R² score + regression plot + feature importances).

Scenario 1 requires 'feature importance ranking of the top 10 microbial taxa', but FR-003/FR-004 reduce ASVs to PCA components before modeling — feature importances will be PC loadings, not taxa, unless a mapping step (PC→taxa loadings) is specified. As written, the acceptance check is ambiguous about what artifact is inspected. Specify that taxa ranking is derived from PC loadings or drop the taxa-level requirement.

'halt execution and log a specific error' for n<30 is testable, but the spec should note HOW this is verified given the Assumption n≥30 — i.e., via a synthetic fixture/unit test of the guard, not an end-to-end public-data input. One clause naming the verification route (unit fixture) makes the edge case reproducibly checkable.
